notes: Budgeted delivery E2, label-free retrieval freeze at gbrain ca2c447bd (overlay): one chunk-unit query call at limit 25 per question (reranked, real embeddings), conversation shards in parallel on one VM per group. No delivery, reader or judge call.

cells.lease_basis: embeddings for the 500 haystacks about $7.65 (plan cost table), 500 frozen queries and 500 readiness probes with the Voyage reranker about $0.80, x1.5 and headroom
cells.command: bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 8 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/lme-s" -- --benchmark lme-s --system gbrain-query --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=freeze
cells.setup_command: BUN_VERSION=1.4.2 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets lme-s && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}

cells.lease_basis: embeddings about $0.13, 707 frozen queries and readiness probes with the reranker about $1.20, x1.5 and headroom
cells.command: bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 3 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/locomo" -- --benchmark locomo --split dev --system gbrain-query --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=freeze; ra=$?; bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 6 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/beam-100k" -- --benchmark beam-100k --split dev --system gbrain-query --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=freeze; rb=$?; exit $((ra | rb))
cells.setup_command: BUN_VERSION=1.4.2 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets locomo,beam-100k && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}
